rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement, or substantial rehabilitation evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of the unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation are owed relocation payments. For eviction notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, the amount is $8,245.00 per tenant, up to $24,733.00 per unit, plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren).
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; $24,733.00 maximum per unit; plus $5,497.00 for each elderly (60 years or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren) (notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation; amount set by the date the eviction notice is served.
rules.exemptions: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.interaction_text: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act are owed relocation payments. For eviction notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, the amount is $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 years or older) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; $33,330.13 maximum per unit; plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 years or older) or disabled tenant (notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act; amount set by the date the eviction notice is served.
